svg.aria-label: A precessing orbit near a compact object
svg.title: A precessing orbit near a compact object
svg.desc: Timelike geodesic of Schwarzschild spacetime over six orbits; the perihelion advances by the same angle each orbit.
svg.text: A precessing orbit near a compact object
r_p = 10 r_s, r_a = 30 r_s: the perihelion advances 0.7439 rad per orbit
